title: サクラチヨノオー登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O has inherited the dream of winning the Japanese Derby from her beloved role model, Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She diligently prepares for the Derby alongside her peers, Mejiro Ardan and Yaeno Muteki, who have garnered much public attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky keeps an eye on her protege from afar. Although Maruzensky hasn't exactly been active in the Twinkle Series lately…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It is Sakura Chiyono O's dream to one day stand as her equal and win against Maruzensky in a race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For that reason, she wants to win the Derby and become a phenomenal racer! Her racing career has just begun, and she's already sprinting out the gates!
